briefdescription.para: Unit tests for VersionManager – content versioning and delta storage (Issue #1692 / content module ROADMAP).

detaileddescription.para:
Tests cover:
Metadata-only version creation via createVersion()
Content-aware version creation via createVersionWithContent()
Content retrieval via getContent()
Delta computation and storage
Version history, getLatestVersion(), hasVersions()
deleteVersion() single and nonexistent version
Static helpers: computeHash(), computeDelta()
Multiple independent content IDs
